# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_1DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-23
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** wiring_proposal
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup currently trades 0DTE options. Holding to 1DTE may reduce theta decay and improve the edge on winning days while reducing losses on losing days, based on the positive DTE trend observed in the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate for the VWAP_CONTINUATION signal.

## Mechanism

Change the DTE parameter for the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup from 0 to 1 (1DTE) in the contract selection logic. All other parameters (strike, exit rules, risk management) remain identical. The entry trigger and context filters are unchanged.
